Treat setup/onboarding steps as conditional and follow only controls supported by current pixels. 1. open Markor; intent: The task requires opening Markor to create a new note. 2. tap the currently visible control described by the step intent; intent: The 'OK' button must be tapped to grant storage permission for the app to proceed. 3. wait briefly only when the visible UI is loading; intent: The screen appears blank or loading; waiting to allow content to render. 4. tap the currently visible control described by the step intent; intent: Enabling file access is necessary for Markor to create and save new notes. 5. return one screen when the current visible setup screen is complete; intent: The file access permission is already granted; returning to Markor to create the note. 6. tap the currently visible control described by the step intent; intent: The red plus button at the bottom right is used to create a new note. 7. enter <task_value_2> into the visible goal-relevant field; intent: The current name field must be cleared and replaced with the required file name. 8. tap the currently visible control described by the step intent; intent: The name is set; confirming creation by tapping OK. 9. enter <task_value_1> into the visible goal-relevant field; intent: The note is open and ready for text input. 10. tap the currently visible control described by the step intent; intent: The save icon is visible and should be tapped to save the note. 11. tap the currently visible control described by the step intent; intent: The note content is entered; saving is the next logical step. 12. perform the visible done operation; intent: The note content matches the task requirement and the file name is correctly set. Do not reuse donor coordinates or literal values; stop only after visible persistence evidence.
